votes.quote: **Bug 1: exactly 10 s uses the wrong format.** Line 5 checks `s <= 10`, but the spec says whole seconds start *at* 10 s. So `10000` gives `"10.0s"` when the spec says `"10s"`. Changing it to `s < 10` fixes this.
